target.title: fix(mcp): soft-fail unconfigured tool registry and lock context factory
target.body:
## Summary

`MCPToolContext.shared` / `makeDefault()` and `ToolRegistry.allTools()` used `fatalError` when their default factories were not configured. An early MCP request or background task that raced `installAgentRuntimeDefaults()` terminated the process.

This PR:

- publishes the MCPToolContext factory under an `NSLock` so concurrent configure/read is coherent;
- makes `makeDefault()` throw a recoverable `PeekabooError` instead of trapping;
- soft-fails `ToolRegistry.allTools()` to an empty list with an error log when services were never installed;
- keeps a last-resort trap only for the non-optional `shared` getter after lock re-check (no valid empty context type exists).

## Failure scenario

1. A code path calls `ToolRegistry.allTools()` or `MCPToolContext.makeDefault()` before `installAgentRuntimeDefaults()`.
2. Unfixed: process aborts via `fatalError`.
3. Fixed: registry returns `[]`; `makeDefault()` throws; factory reads see a lock-published configure.

## Verification

- `swift build --target PeekabooAgentRuntime` in `Core/PeekabooCore` → complete
- Host lacks full Xcode.app; CI remains the suite of record for Swift Testing targets.

## Scope

Default-factory publication and unconfigured handling only. Configured production paths are unchanged once `installAgentRuntimeDefaults()` has run.
